mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material_package_spec (material_id, origin, package_weight, package_unit_label) VALUES (#{materialId}, #{origin}, #{packageWeight}, #{packageUnitLabel})
mapper.select: SELECT spec_id, material_id, origin, package_weight, package_unit_label, created_at, updated_at FROM material_package_spec WHERE material_id = #{materialId} ORDER BY origin
